newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks turn choppy, cling to moderate gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks turn choppy, cling to moderate gains.

text.p: Wall Street stocks slipped well off their session peaks in late afternoon, as the market grew increasingly choppy and investors appeared to begin taking profits in the last hour of trading.
The Dow was up 39 points at 7001, more than 50 points off the blue chip average's high for the day. The S&P 500 eased back below the 800-level to 799, up five for the session.
"Some profit-taking is well overdue," said Dick Stein, vice president at U.S. Clearing Corp.
